description.value: Cahilty Creek Kitchen & Taproom is an independently owned restaurant and taproom at Sun Peaks Resort, operating since 2011 with 16 taps of BC craft beers, premium cocktails, and BC wines alongside a seasonal comfort-food menu. Located slope-side off the Gentle Giant ski run and attached to Nancy Greene's Cahilty Lodge, the venue advertises hike, bike, or ski-in/ski-out access and claims some of the highest patios in the village with panoramic mountain views. Touring cyclists riding the Sun Peaks trail network will find full breakfast-through-dinner service, takeout, and a welcoming locals-owned atmosphere.

address.value: 3220 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at cahiltycreek.com confirms the business at 3220 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC with a matching phone number (250-434-0279); the OSM 'website' tag incorrectly contains the email address cahiltycreek1@gmail.com rather than a URL, which the website itself also lists as its contact email. Takeout is explicitly stated ('absolutely, takeout is available') and online ordering is offered; vegetarian options are evidenced by multiple menu items (Avocado Toast, Miso Tofu Bites, Fruit & Yogurt Parfait) corroborating the OSM diet:vegetarian=yes tag. No mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the website.
